name: Kitchen
description: Horizon trap: the most valuable process is too slow to finish before T.
comment: Hand-computed optimum = 6. 'hatch' (egg -> chicken worth 20) takes 10 ticks but T = 5, so it can never be scheduled. The only useful move is 'fry' (egg worth 1 -> omelette worth 3, 1 tick); both eggs can be fried: 2 * 3 = 6.
